question.problem:
Determine a set of parametric equations, defined for $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ),$ that generate the horizontal parabola given by the Cartesian equation ${y}^{2}=-24x.$ Express your answer in the form $x=p{t}^{2},y=2pt,$ where $p$ is a constant.

$x=$
{{field-1}},
$\,y=$
{{field-2}}
question.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a horizontal parabola ${y}^{2}=4px$ that has its vertex at $(0,0)$ are

$$
x=p{t}^{2},\,y=2pt,
$$

where $p$ is constant.

Comparing the given Cartesian equation with the general case ${y}^{2}=4px$ and solving for $p,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4px & =-24x \\ 4p & =-24 \\ p & =-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the parametric equations of the parabola are

$$
x=(-6){t}^{2},\,y=2(-6)t,
$$

which simplify to

$$
x=-6{t}^{2},\,y=-12t.
$$
